messages:
marie (AE): HelioCore execs pushed for a firm POC runway and reserved-capacity quote. They want EU-only data, BYOK option, and a SOC2 + KMS attestation. If we can't firm numbers by Fri they'll ask for an exec bridge.

jason (SE): Understood. Need workload profile: avg/peak RPS, seq lengths, token distribution, and example prompts. Any SLA p95 target?

marie (AE): They've asked for 50 rps sustained, 150 rps peak, p95 <200ms on common prompts. Initial pilot to run in eu-west-1, data residency mandatory.

elena (Eng-Infra): 50/150 rps is feasible on Dedicated with A10G-class instances and proper batching/KV warmup. BYOK is fine but adds key provisioning steps. We'll need sample corpus to size KV cache.

jason (SE): I'll prepare a perf sketch & sequence-length histogram. Will include curl examples and smoke test commands.

sam (CS): Compliance note: SOC2 attestation + KMS attestation typically 5 business days for our side once CDA signed and we get a clear key ownership decision. Customer offering BYOK will speed some parts but we still need network diag and contact list.

rachel (Legal): I'll prepare a short CDA addendum and a minimal checklist for eng. Need to know cert requirements for any peered endpoints and exact log retention requested.

priya (RevOps): Pricing ask: they want 20% off for a 3-month USB (reserved commit). Our standard short-commit discount caps near 10%. For 20% we need exec approval or a higher committed spend. Suggest 12% + onboarding credits as a close option.

marie (AE): Action plan: @jason -> traffic + payloads by EOD; @elena -> sizing & runbook (including warmup steps) by tomorrow 12:00 UTC; @priya -> draft pricing scenarios and margin impact by tomorrow 15:00 UTC; @rachel -> CDA addendum + checklist asap. If CDA not returned by Fri, I'll request exec bridge and tag @noah.

elena (Eng-Infra): Quick runbook snippet for SE/ops:

```
1) provision --region=eu-west-1 --gpu=a10g --replicas=3
2) set-route --policy=canary --fallback=hosted-eu
3) kv-warm --corpus=sample_prompts --duration=10m
4) smoke: POST /v1/generate {"prompt":"<sample>", "max_tokens":128}
5) observe: p95 latency + token-cost. Alert if p95>250ms
```

jason (SE): I'll attach perf artifacts and a small corpus tonight.

priya (RevOps): I'll model 3 options: (A) 10% discount standard commit, (B) 12% + $5k onboarding credit, (C) 20% requires exec signoff or 6-month commit. Will share slides tomorrow.

sam (CS): Updating the internal deal doc with the legal checklist and onboarding steps.

marie (AE): FYI customer ok with BYOK but asked if Redwood can manage keys for speed. We'll propose both paths with an implementation timeline.

rachel (Legal): Draft ready in 2 hours. Will include a short items list for infra and a minimal CDA addendum.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: all services nominal.

noah (CTO): I can join an exec bridge Mon morning if needed. Keep me posted before Friday.

marie (AE): Thanks team. I'll update HelioCore once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
